resources.string: All four steps are needed for SpamBlok to screen calls and show its banner.
Calls from any number starting with a prefix below are rejected silently (no ring, no notification).

Import a plain-text list of known spam numbers you\'ve downloaded yourself (one number per line, "#" for comments — e.g. a Yet Another Call Blocker export). A match upgrades the on-call verdict shown on SpamBlok\'s banner; it does not block the call. Nothing is uploaded, and SpamBlok does not bundle or redistribute anyone else\'s list.
Every number/name SpamBlok has read off a banner, stored locally. Looked up first on the next call from that number.

Reads the caller name shown by Truecaller/the in-call UI during an incoming call, for SpamBlok\'s own caller-ID overlay. This build only logs locally — it stores and sends nothing.
